replacement.title: Khan Academy: Statistics and Probability
replacement.evidence: Khan Academy support page: 'always free'. Canonical URL confirmed; unit list renders client-side and could not be read.
replacement.why: Beginner course spanning descriptive statistics, sampling, probability, sampling distributions/CLT, confidence intervals, significance tests, chi-square and ANOVA — the same syllabus as Stanford's Introduction to Statistics. Already listed in the source repo for this topic.
replacement.gap: None material at this level; no resampling unit (bootstrap is covered by the Data 8 textbook replacement below).
